selection_rationale: Uniform 2g destroyer wall: 8 hulls keep the whole fleet at matched speed (no mixed-doctrine kiting problem), maximize hull count for PD coverage and battle damage distribution, and field 8 spinal coilguns plus 8 secondary coilguns for strong combined alpha strike. Speed lets us dictate engagement range against slower capital-heavy fleets and against torpedo boats we can out-maneuver and thin salvos with 16 PD turrets total.
formation_rationale: All 8 destroyers form a dispersed spherical shell around the fleet anchor, roughly 70-90km apart from nearest neighbors — close enough to maintain overlapping point-defense coverage against torpedoes, but spread across y/z axes to deny the enemy a clean spinal-weapon lance-through. The slight -x/+x stagger (forward quartet proud at +25km, rear quartet held at -20km) means the forward four absorb the first exchange and screen the deeper four, while all ships remain mutually supporting rather than presenting a flat line-abreast target.
